contract.source: original_package.work.completion embedded in the exact e69 observer receipt
contract.text: Every exact interval is either a qualified additive repair to its recorded location or a documented exception; run actual selected-native conservation and source/physical witness checks. Existing river water remains location-owned.
contract.interpretation: Each exact held interval receives an explicit unresolved proposed disposition with its facts, bounded reason and next evidence. A proposal is not accepted repair or exception credit.

component_review.limitation: Numerical membership and original-component attribution only; no territorial or legal approval.

limitations: Native diagnostic screening only; no authority products, current-owner-zero, acceptance or whole-source clearance.
All original source, physical, query, witness and territorial limits remain retained.

limits: The e69 receipt records literal selected-product ownership only; scientific_qualification is false and it does not certify source applicability, municipal status, legal boundaries, physical clearance or package completion.
The original-source center match and component crosswalk describe retained source geometry, not current applicability or full-island completeness.
The 87 2018 contextual contacts (85 Port Vila and 2 Luganville) are preserved as adverse historical context, not a legal boundary finding. The 1,116 no-hit keys are not cleared.
Retained physical support is target-level. It does not establish a per-key foreign contact; the source and physical evidence references retain their stated scope.
All proposed unresolved dispositions remain unaccepted pending distinct exact-head review and root acceptance; no repair or exception credit is claimed.
The frozen package contains 0 inland-water cells; any existing river-water owner remains location-owned under the issue contract.
